title: AWS Transform is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
summary: Discover more about what's new at AWS with AWS Transform is now available in AWS GovCloud (US-West)
body_markdown:
AWS Transform is now available in the AWS GovCloud (US-West) Region, enabling government agencies and regulated organizations to plan and execute large-scale migrations to AWS. With this launch, customers operating in AWS GovCloud (US) can use the[migration capabilities](https://aws.amazon.com/transform/migrations) of AWS Transform to automate server migrations within an isolated environment designed to host sensitive data and regulated workloads. AWS Transform in this Region supports migrating servers to both AWS GovCloud (US-East) and AWS GovCloud (US-West) as[target Regions](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transform/latest/userguide/transform-vmware-connect-target-account.html#transform-vmware-cta-supported-regions) .


Organizations migrating VMware, bare metal, Hyper-V, or database workloads can use AWS Transform to automate server replication and cutover, reducing the manual effort and risk involved in large-scale moves. This is particularly valuable for federal agencies, defense contractors, and regulated industries that must operate within the AWS GovCloud (US) boundary. Modernization, custom transformation, and assessment capabilities are not included in this regional launch and remain available in supported commercial Regions.


To get started, see the AWS Transform[documentation](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/transform/latest/userguide/) or visit the AWS Transform[product page](https://aws.amazon.com/transform/) .
